visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Halve the Exponent Instead of Subtracting One
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This power function makes one recursive call per unit of the exponent. Rewrite it to halve the exponent each time. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Halving the exponent makes the recursion about log2(exp) calls deep instead of exp calls deep, so huge exponents no longer risk exhausting the stack.
